notes.notes:
🚗 Hey Awesome Drivers!

It’s time for the next Weekly Update! As always, in a few points, we’re presenting to you what we've been working on this week in Used Cars Simulator 😀 Just a reminder – we’re showing what we're working on in the whole project. These are NOT the updates to the demo – it's the same as before 😀 

[b]1. Toilets [/b]

In Used Cars Simulator, you'll need to take care of your character's stats. One of these is the bladder level. Toilets will come in handy for meeting this need ;) We've placed them at various points on the map so you can easily find them in different locations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/cc3ee0ccd76cddebca7f5d7cdc3b83affe39a552.gif[/img]

[b]2. Character Parameters - Notifications [/b]

We’re adding notifications about your character's stats so you'll know when it’s time to head to the bathroom, grab something to eat, or get some sleep.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/30235c008319d1ab3e54ada71895637d7fa1e9a2.png[/img]

If you ignore these needs, there will be consequences. For example, if you don't go to bed and fall asleep somewhere on the street - you might get robbed

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/619500f1f43e1fddf10bdeff4e85f273734c27ee.png[/img]

Or if you don’t make it to the toilet in time, you’ll wet your pants (this will increase your Criminality level).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/74ecdb00a6c73e80d9af9f04ebd5cb4cd65fd46d.png[/img]

[b]3. Negotiations [/b]

We’re improving the negotiation system. Sellers will offer you a price, but you can try to negotiate it. If you take the time to approach the car and carefully inspect the individual parts, you will have a better understanding of the car's condition - and this will allow you to lower the price.

We want the negotiations to feel realistic and keep them within fair limits. However, if you push too hard and repeatedly offer too low a price, the seller may get offended and refuse to talk to you anymore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/0024ebd2d34776080d8a9ae1d60d303eaa440ff1.gif[/img]

[b]4. Prices [/b]

We’re also improving a calculating prices system. The cost of a car will depend on its parts and their condition (the condition includes dents, dirt, and fresh paint coverage).

If you don’t have much money, you’ll only be able to afford a cheap car, which might be dirty or damaged. But you can always fix it later and earn more money! 😀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/66b7cc1899641565892190ddfbd264cf04996a2b.gif[/img]

[b]5. Settings [/b]

We’re adding more options to Settings and making sure you can adjust them freely. For example, if you set everything to Low, the other settings will automatically switch to Low as well. But if you want to customize specific settings differently, you’ll be able to change them easily, too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/ebca2fdbd7c9bd26d181e1b1028a03c1eebb64d3.gif[/img]

[b]6. Optimization [/b]

We’re still working on optimization - it’s a complex process. Our goal is to make sure the game isn’t too demanding on computers while also running smoothly. We’re testing various materials, terrains, and textures to see how they affect memory usage and FPS, and finding ways to improve performance wherever possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/1efa1a8faf2d383491b74b7a2b7789f6cc0cf7b5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/9d1b268045aa1e126f4948f7b19910917360ba41.gif[/img]

🚗 Hey Awesome Drivers!

It’s time for the next Weekly Update! As usual, in a few points, we'll present to you what we've been working on this week in Used Cars Simulator 😀

[b]1. Visual - Night [/b]

We are working on the night-time visual. Such adjustments make the night in the game bright enough to move around and see all objects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/db00e9533c19c4a1a6cc01436369231cfc092542.gif[/img]

[b]2. Visual - Reflections[/b]

We worked on reflections. Not everyone realizes that it is the reflections on the paint of the car that make the whole game look much better 😀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/b706b5d482ca22a1140faa9e7798843bfef33997.gif[/img]

And this is what preparing for such a task looks like 😀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/bf487bde832782595d378a2cb0243a5065233209.gif[/img]

[b]3. Market[/b]

We are adding a store to the city. It's still quite empty for now 😀 But you'll be able to find various essential tools there. We also started implementing a system for buying items and tools.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/bd1c6b7967ff889d2c101a86fa4c72c06ff0b38e.gif[/img]

[b]4. New NPC[/b]

We’re working on a new NPC - he will have a special role in the initial quests of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/68472a3b28c5aed72314963e314b790622352045.gif[/img]

[b]5. Deformations and Missing Parts[/b]

We’re still improving the deformation system. Using the baseball bat is now causing damage not only to the part we hit but also to the surrounding parts (and it’s visible on the car’s plan, too).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/645258116e2e49ba7470457eae604ed85b5948b9.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/9e022fb44f9c3d42debbe76a10e9c0231ac92bac.png[/img]

- red, which will indicate the quest location

- blue, which will show where you can pick up packages ordered on UsedBay

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/d2f081aaff176d55dc18be571afefc57ad4f0534.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/79bfd4d3eba66cd74aa6fb7cea07d33aa78f24e3.gif[/img]

notes.title: Used Cars Simulator - Tool Showcase - Powerwash
notes.notes:
🚗 Hey Awesome Drivers!

As we announced earlier, we will be presenting various mechanics from our game to you and asking for your opinions on them, as well as suggestions for further development.

[h3]We're starting with a powerwash ːsteamhappyː
[/h3]
Buying a used car usually involves the need to thoroughly clean the vehicle. A clean car is also certainly easier to sell ;)

That's why we're adding a [b]powerwash[/b] to the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/b8c9a4ebf513590ea7bcb47cd2a671bf7dc23425.png[/img]

The user interface (UI) will show the car's cleanliness level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/b3dc113997ebcce0e2317fdd09c0b3ed491269bf.png[/img]

During the creation process, we also need to test the... power of our powerwash ːsteamhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/0531dab684e058c30a5ea37a44dd4d39c2598179.gif[/img]

So as you can see, besides the cleaning, it can be a lot of fun while using it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/0de0cef8f75ed35a5f2d6dd8853bed91e15e48b9.gif[/img]

We have several ideas for expanding and utilizing this feature in the game, but we also want to hear your opinions.
